component.name: Grabbit
component.summary: Download video and music from YouTube and Spotify
Scarica video e musica da YouTube e Spotify

description.p: Grabbit downloads video and music with a simple interface, using yt-dlp. It searches YouTube and YouTube Music (songs, albums, videos and an artist's whole discography), saves audio as MP3, M4A, Opus, OGG, FLAC or WAV with cover art and metadata, downloads several tracks at once and includes a player to listen to the downloaded music.

Grabbit scarica video e musica con un'interfaccia semplice, usando yt-dlp. Cerca su YouTube e YouTube Music (brani, album, video e la discografia completa di un artista), salva l'audio in MP3, M4A, Opus, OGG, FLAC o WAV con copertina e metadati, scarica più brani insieme e ha un player per ascoltare la musica scaricata.
